SPACE CRAFT JOURNAL / STYLE & MATERIAL DIRECTION

Must have features for a luxury modern office design.

Use a style as a starting point, not a formula. This Space Craft planning note looks at must have features for a luxury modern office design through the choices that affect everyday use, the details worth testing and the questions to take into your project brief.

Space Craft editorialPlanning note · 4 min read
IN THIS NOTEName what you want from the referenceBalance character with daily useBuild a coherent material familyMap activity before assigning desksBefore you decide
01 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Name what you want from the reference

When an image appeals to you, identify why: the light, proportions, texture, restraint or sense of openness. Translate those qualities into your own brief rather than copying the whole room.

02 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Balance character with daily use

An exposed structure, pale finish or highly polished surface has practical implications. Review cleaning, durability, glare and sound alongside the intended look.

03 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Build a coherent material family

A small group of related finishes can make the space feel connected. Test the transitions between reception, work areas and enclosed rooms so that the story remains consistent.

04 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Map activity before assigning desks

Write down the tasks people perform, how often teams overlap and when visitors arrive. A desk count alone will not reveal the need for private calls, project tables or storage.

BEFORE YOU DECIDE

Take this into your brief.

  • Choose references for specific qualities.
  • Test durability and maintenance assumptions.
  • Review samples as a connected palette.

Write down one priority, one constraint and one question you still need to answer. Review them beside the plan or material sample before agreeing the next design decision.

General design considerations for discussion. Product suitability, technical performance, statutory requirements and project pricing need appropriate, project-specific review. Images are illustrative.
